annotations.description:
The per-feed sanity check rated TRG/USD as BROKEN (status 2) for over 10 minutes: the value published on Cardano differs from the latest DIA source price beyond the configured tolerance AND is stale past its freshness window. This is a DATA-ACCURACY signal — the on-chain oracle no longer reflects the DIA source.
WHAT TO DO: 1. Inspect the deviation / staleness — query the API or run the
   on-demand check:
     curl -s localhost:8080/api/v1/alerts
     cd offchain/feeder && npm run sanity:feeds
2. Confirm the feeder is still publishing TRG/USD and that
   the DIA source is delivering fresh intents for it:
     cd offchain && make logs
3. A feed that stays BROKEN means the on-chain pair stopped tracking the
   source — investigate the submission path for that pair. No wallet
   top-up fixes a data-accuracy fault.
annotations.summary: On-chain value for TRG/USD disagrees with the DIA source
